title: THE BOUNTY READS $1,500
why: Every money figure on the screen reads with its comma ($1,234), through one helper. The bounty pillager built three of his texts by hand, so the BOUNTY ON THE MAP alert, its feed line and the label on his ring read $1500 (and player 2's alert too), while BOUNTY CLAIMED, a moment later, read +$1,500. Proven in headless Chromium on real frames: the ring drew BOUNTY  $1500 and the alert said HE HUNTS YOU  $1500, then BOUNTY CLAIMED  +$1,500. The three now use the same helper as every other figure.
now: The bounty now reads $1,500 with its comma everywhere it shows.

edits.anchor: try{ say('BOUNTY ON THE MAP','warn',{sub:'HE HUNTS YOU  $'+BOUNTY.pay}); }catch(_bs){}
edits.replacement: try{ say('BOUNTY ON THE MAP','warn',{sub:'HE HUNTS YOU  '+arcadeCr(BOUNTY.pay)}); }catch(_bs){}   // v16.xx (cloud-raid-bountycomma), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: $1,500 with its comma, as everywhere else
